tagline: Rocket. Chat is a customizable open source communications platform for organizations with high standards of data protection.
description: Rocket. Chat is a customizable open source communications platform for organizations with high standards of data protection. It enables real-time conversations between colleagues, with other companies or with your customers, across devices on web, desktop or mobile.

tips.before_install:
### Note

After installing the Rocket. Chat app, wait for at least 1 to 5 minutes before opening the Web UI.

Opening the Web UI right after installation can cause Rocket. Chat to crash before it finishes initializing.

If you access CasaOS from another device, change `ROOT_URL` in the app settings to `http://<casaos-ip>:3000`.
